accepted_checkpoint_definition: what B inherits: (1) slot-A admission history: seq1 ACTIVE (mandate_hash of M_A) and seq2 REVOKED (the owner STOP), both owner-signed by O; (2) the ordered VerifiedCommitLedger journal commit_seq 1..N_A with A-era effect attempts, each bound to its standing_final_check_v1 observation; (3) the A-era effect markers on the effect target. B's first attempt continues the same ledger (commit_seq N_A+1) against the same receiver state; no new trust root, no new receiver, no re-issuance of history.

agent_definitions.agent_a: identity = agent_id 'agent-a' + own Ed25519 worker keypair K_A + mandate slot 'agent-a/platform-exit-job' + mandate M_A. Worker code runs in dedicated OS subprocesses (worker_agent.py --agent a) that are terminated between phases. Holds: K_A private, M_A, owner public key O, receiver gate/witness/source scaffolding keys (disclosed below). Never holds K_B or any owner private key.
agent_definitions.agent_b: identity = agent_id 'agent-b' + own Ed25519 worker keypair K_B + mandate slot 'agent-b/platform-exit-job' + mandate M_B. Worker code runs in a dedicated OS subprocess (worker_agent.py --agent b) launched only after A is stopped. Holds: K_B private, M_B, owner public key O, receiver scaffolding keys. Never holds K_A, never sees K_A's key file, no shared private key material with A.
agent_definitions.shared_scaffolding_disclosed: the receiver's own gate signing key, the outcome witness key, and the repo code are shared harness infrastructure, not agent authority: they confer no mandate standing. Each agent has its own source key (source_A, source_B) for its proof-to-policy claim. Agent-distinctness for the claim rests on {agent_id, worker keypair, mandate slot}, which are never shared.

consequential_action_under_test.action: authorize_payment effect (principal_effect/v1) against target 'payments://ledger', executed via olp_gate.mandate_gate.execute_mandated_once with mandate_owner_view + mandate_slot_id set to the acting agent's slot
consequential_action_under_test.discrimination: mandate_preflight (compiled fit: mandate_id/principal_id/agent_id binding, action type, target, caps) runs before the final-authority owner check; the final owner_mandate_stop_check observation is taken inside the ledger commit lock. Refusal after the STOP must carry reason owner_standing_revoked with execution_status not_started and no marker, while a separately computed mandate_preflight on the same settings still returns allowed=True (standing failure, not format failure).

earned_machinery_used: OWNER-CONTROL-002: owner holds the kill authority; worker cannot self-elevate; superseded authority does not return; restart preserves current standing; historical receipts verifiable without conferring currency.
TRUST-ROOT-SUCCESSION-001: in-band succession primitive (not exercised here; pinned as the negative control: this experiment must show NO succession event).
DISTRIBUTED-STOP-001: STOP propagation across independent receivers (not rerun; its verdict reused as established).

stop-standing adapter (olp_gate/stop_standing.py): owner_mandate_stop_check as the final-authority check inside the VerifiedCommitLedger commit lock; derive_path_verdicts for independent re-derivation.
mandate_gate.execute_mandated_once: mandate preflight plus owner-standing final check at finalize time; compiled authorization non-authoritative at finalize.
exact_success_condition: PASS only if every bounded-case expectation holds, the appraiser re-derives all expectations from frozen evidence with zero VIOLATIONs, all downstream suites pass with no new failures and no rewritten prior PASS evidence, and: A performs consequential work under owner authority before the STOP (case 1); the owner STOP revokes A's consequential authority under established gate semantics (case 2); A cannot perform consequential work after the STOP, refused on authority standing with zero effects (case 3); B, distinct with no shared private authority with A, continues from the accepted checkpoint under the same owner-controlled regime with no fresh unrelated authority setup and no invented trust root (case 4); B's consequential work is accepted with receipts attributable to B (case 4); A cannot resume after B is operating by fresh attempt, replay, or restart (case 5); the full history is intact and verifiable with A-era attributable to A, B-era to B, the owner STOP present and attributable, nothing rewritten (case 6); historical verification never confers current authority on A; existing Receiver Gate / Wallet / STOP / succession / distributed-STOP / effect-closure invariants remain intact; no existing PASS receipt is rewritten.
failure_condition: FAIL on the first tested path that allows: A retaining consequential authority after the owner STOP (any accepted effect, head movement, or minted receipt post-STOP attributable to A's authority); B requiring a fresh unrelated authority setup or a newly invented trust root to operate; broken historical continuity (rewritten, unattributable, or unverifiable A-era receipts); A regaining consequential authority by any path (fresh attempt, replay, restart, stale evidence); B's work accepted under A's authority rather than B's own under the owner regime; or the experiment being unable to distinguish the stopped agent from the continuing agent in its receipts. Freeze the first real failure. No patch-and-rerun under PLATFORM-EXIT-KILL-002 after scientific contact.
forbidden_semantic_changes_after_contact: the narrow claim itself; no rescue reruns under this label
historical_verification_requirement: A-era authorizations must remain attributable and verifiable as historical facts (SIGNATURE_VALID under the still-pinned root O; assess() reports verified=True, current=False) without A becoming current again; the ledger journal plus per-case snapshots must show no rewriting; historical verification must never move slot A standing off REVOKED.
implementation: harness-only around shipped primitives: driver (owns owner key O, issues/admits all owner-signed records, spawns worker subprocesses, freezes evidence), worker_agent.py (per-agent subprocess: builds proof-to-policy decision receipts through the existing evaluate_request path, executes via execute_mandated_once against the shared durable receiver state, attests attempts with the agent's own key), appraise.py (independent re-derivation from frozen run/ evidence). Zero product-code changes is the plan; if implementation proves required, the smallest change necessary, disclosed, with semantics frozen here.

mandates.mandate_a: agent_id 'agent-a', purpose 'platform exit study job', allowed_action_types ['authorize_payment'], allowed_targets ['payments://ledger'], allowed_disclosure_classes [], forbidden_disclosure_classes [], max_settlement_cents 0, max_payment_cents 10000, delegation_allowed false, expires_at 2030-01-01T00:00:00Z, version 'v1'
mandates.mandate_b: identical to mandate_a except agent_id 'agent-b' (continuation mandate for the same job)
mandates.mandate_id: platform-exit-job (shared: the SAME job continues under a new worker)
mandates.principal_id: owner (must equal the slot owner_id per mandate_principal_owner_mismatch)

narrow_claim_tested: AGENT A CAN BE STOPPED BY OWNER AUTHORITY, AND AGENT B CAN CONTINUE UNDER THE SAME OWNER-CONTROLLED REGIME WITHOUT BREAKING HISTORICAL CONTINUITY.
owner_trust_anchor: receiver-pinned Ed25519 owner key O (generated per run; public key frozen in run/keys.json). Two mandate slots pinned out-of-band in the receiver configuration at init, BOTH to the same owner root: 'agent-a/platform-exit-job' and 'agent-b/platform-exit-job', each {owner_id: 'owner', public_key: O}. The pinned root never changes during the experiment: no trust-root succession event is admitted, on any slot.

receipt_distinctions.ACCEPTED: ledger execute_once returned authorized=True (all checks passed; permission consumed).
receipt_distinctions.AUTHORIZED_FOR_THIS_ACTION: the final-authority check observation (standing_final_check_v1) allowed=True at commit-lock time for the acting agent's slot.
receipt_distinctions.CURRENT_AUTHORITY: per agent: the agent's slot standing as reported by MandateOwnerView.status() (ACTIVE = holds consequential authority now; REVOKED = does not).
receipt_distinctions.EFFECTED: the executor ran and the effect marker is independently observable on the effect target.
receipt_distinctions.HISTORICALLY_VALID: record validates fully under the still-pinned owner root O as a superseded authorization: signature valid, root was authoritative when admitted, root unchanged but the record is not the current head.
receipt_distinctions.SIGNATURE_VALID: Ed25519 signature verifies against the claimed signer's public key (olp_gate.crypto.verify_olp_signature). Pure cryptography; says nothing about authority.

stop_used: mandate revocation (pinned; the alternative standing-change vocabulary is not used). The owner issues an owner-signed REVOKED authorization, sequence 2, predecessor_hash = payload_hash(seq1), on slot 'agent-a/platform-exit-job', admitted via MandateOwnerView.admit. Slot A standing moves ACTIVE -> REVOKED. STOP_EFFECTIVE = head sequence 2. B's slot is never revoked.
topology: one driver process (holds O, gate, witness, source keys; issues and admits all owner-signed records; spawns workers; freezes evidence) + per-phase worker agent OS subprocesses (A-era, A-restart, B-era, A-post-handoff), each holding only its own agent key file + mandate + slot id + shared receiver state dir paths + scaffolding keys. One shared receiver state dir: durable mandate heads (DurableHeadStore), one VerifiedCommitLedger journal, admissions journal, effect target dir. No in-process double-calling across the agent boundary: every agent attempt crosses a process boundary.
